title: Detailed windmill
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sky glow behind windmill, subtle -->
  <rect x='0' y='0' width='100' height='100' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Ground / hill -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='48' ry='12' fill='#2a7a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='91' rx='44' ry='9' fill='#3a9e4a'/>
  
  <!-- Windmill tower body -->
  <polygon points='42,88 58,88 54,40 46,40' fill='#d4a056'/>
  <!-- Tower shading right side -->
  <polygon points='50,88 58,88 54,40 50,40' fill='#b8843a'/>
  <!-- Tower horizontal brick lines -->
  <line x1='43.5' y1='72' x2='56.5' y2='72' stroke='#e8c07a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='44.5' y1='60' x2='55.5' y2='60' stroke='#e8c07a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='45.5' y1='50' x2='54.5' y2='50' stroke='#e8c07a' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Door -->
  <rect x='47' y='76' width='6' height='12' rx='1' fill='#6b3a1a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='82' r='0.8' fill='#ffd700'/>
  
  <!-- Window on tower -->
  <rect x='47' y='58' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#1a4a8a'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='50' y2='63' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <line x1='47' y1='60.5' x2='53' y2='60.5' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Windmill cap / roof -->
  <polygon points='40,42 60,42 54,30 46,30' fill='#c04040'/>
  <polygon points='50,42 60,42 54,30 50,30' fill='#a03030'/>
  
  <!-- Hub / axle center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#ffd700'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='2' fill='#ffaa00'/>
  
  <!-- Windmill blades - 4 arms -->
  <!-- Blade 1: upper-right -->
  <g>
    <line x1='50' y1='36' x2='68' y2='14' stroke='#e8e8e8' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <!-- Lattice frame -->
    <line x1='52' y1='33' x2='66' y2='16' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='28' x2='70' y2='18' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='58' y1='26' x2='56' y2='24' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <!-- Sail fill -->
    <polygon points='50,36 68,14 72,20 54,38' fill='#d0d8e8' opacity='0.5'/>
    <!-- Detail ribs -->
    <line x1='56' y1='30' x2='64' y2='20' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='0.6'/>
    <line x1='60' y1='26' x2='68' y2='16' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Blade 2: upper-left -->
  <g>
    <line x1='50' y1='36' x2='32' y2='14' stroke='#e8e8e8' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='48' y1='33' x2='34' y2='16' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='46' y1='28' x2='30' y2='18' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1'/>
    <polygon points='50,36 32,14 28,20 46,38' fill='#d0d8e8' opacity='0.5'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='30' x2='36' y2='20' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='0.6'/>
    <line x1='40' y1='26' x2='32' y2='16' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Blade 3: lower-right -->
  <g>
    <line x1='50' y1='36' x2='68' y2='58' stroke='#e8e8e8' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='52' y1='39' x2='66' y2='56' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='44' x2='70' y2='54' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1'/>
    <polygon points='50,36 68,58 72,52 54,34' fill='#d0d8e8' opacity='0.5'/>
    <line x1='56' y1='42' x2='64' y2='52' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='0.6'/>
    <line x1='60' y1='46' x2='68' y2='56' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Blade 4: lower-left -->
  <g>
    <line x1='50' y1='36' x2='32' y2='58' stroke='#e8e8e8' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='48' y1='39' x2='34' y2='56' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='46' y1='44' x2='30' y2='54' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1'/>
    <polygon points='50,36 32,58 28,52 46,34' fill='#d0d8e8' opacity='0.5'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='42' x2='36' y2='52' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='0.6'/>
    <line x1='40' y1='46' x2='32' y2='56' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Small decorative bushes -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='90' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#4ac06a'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='91' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#4ac06a'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='90' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#5ad07a'/>
  
  <!-- Tiny flowers -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='89' r='1' fill='#ff6688'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='90' r='0.8' fill='#ffaa33'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='91' r='0.8' fill='#ff6688'/>
</svg>
